    Trail SnacksAlphabet crackersCheddar crackers cut into letters, for the day E.T. learns EnglishHow to make it150g cheddar, grated60g cold butter, cubed100g plain flourpinch of salt1 tbsp cold waterHeat the oven to 180°C. Pulse the cheddar, butter, flour and salt until it looks like crumbs.Add a splash of water and pulse until it forms a dough.Roll thin and cut into letters with small cutters.Bake on lined trays until crisp and golden.Cool on the trays so they crisp up.Halloween caramel popcorn and lolly mixPopped corn baked in a brown sugar and golden syrup glaze, chocolate buttons, jellies and peanutsHow to make it120g popcorn kernels100g butter200g brown sugar3 tbsp golden syrup1/2 tsp bicarb soda150g chocolate buttons150g jelly lollies80g roasted peanutsHeat the oven to 120°C. Pop the corn and tip it into a large roasting tray.Melt the butter with the brown sugar and golden syrup, boil for 4 minutes, then stir in the bicarb and a pinch of salt.Pour over the popcorn and toss well.Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.Cool, break up and toss with the chocolate buttons, jelly lollies and peanuts.Peanut butter and grape jelly sandwichesPacked for the forest, ready to phone home.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Mess Hall MainsGame night pepperoni pizzaPepperoni pizza in squares, as Michael's friends wait on the pizza manHow to make it500g pizza dough1 jar pizza sauce250g mozzarella100g pepperoniHeat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.Stretch the dough into two thin bases.Spread with pizza sauce and top with the mozzarella and pepperoni.Bake until the crust is blistered and the cheese is bubbling.Cut into squares for the whole family.Elliott's toasted ham and cheese trianglesLeg ham, Swiss and mustard butter pan-fried, apple slaw, for when the frogs go freeHow to make itNot on tonight's cookLeg ham, Swiss cheese and a smear of mustard butter toasted in a pan until golden and melting, cut into triangles with crunchy apple slaw.Mash 60g soft butter with 1 tsp mild mustard.Butter the outsides of 8 slices of white bread.Fill each pair with 2 slices leg ham and 2 slices Swiss cheese.Toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted, pressing down with a spatula.Toss 2 grated apples and 1 grated carrot with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon juice.Cut the toasties into triangles and serve with the slaw.Campfire TreatsHomemade peanut butter cupsElliott fakes sick to stay home with E.T. Milk chocolate and peanut butter cupsHow to make it300g milk chocolate150g peanut butter50g icing sugarMelt the chocolate gently.Spoon a little into 12 cupcake liners, spreading up the sides, and chill until set.Mix the peanut butter with the icing sugar and put a spoon in each cup.Cover with the rest of the chocolate and chill until set.Peanut butter candy trailPeanut butter discs in candy melts, like Reese's PiecesHow to make it200g peanut butter100g icing sugar30g butter, soft250g coloured candy meltsBeat the peanut butter, icing sugar and soft butter until smooth.Roll into small discs and chill until firm.Melt the candy melts gently, dip each disc and set on baking paper.Lay them in a trail across the table.Canteen DrinksFridge raid root beer floatsE.T. raids the fridge while Elliott's at school. Root beer, vanilla ice cream, chocolateHow to make it1 L root beer8 scoops of vanilla ice cream2 tbsp chocolate syrupChill four tall glasses in the freezer.Add two scoops of ice cream to each glass.Pour the cold root beer slowly down the side so the foam rises without spilling over.Drizzle with chocolate syrup and serve with long spoons and straws.
